pages.title: American Mastodon
pages.text: The American mastodon ($(o)Mammut americanum$()) is an extinct proboscidean that lived across North America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)Mastodons were not true elephants or mammoths, but belonged to a separate family. They were shorter and stockier than mammoths, with long, upward-curving tusks.$(br2)Their molars bore cone-shaped cusps suited to browsing, and they fed on twigs, leaves and shrubs in forests and wetlands.
